mapper.select: SELECT to_char(holiday_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", name FROM holiday WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY holiday_date
SELECT count(*) FROM holiday WHERE holiday_date = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holiday (holiday_date, name) VALUES (#{date}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT (holiday_date) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
